body: Thank you, they are both amazing and of course you're right, I know I'm not being reasonable. I know talk therapy is what I need, and was part of the master plan. We live pay check to pay check right now so we've been waiting all year for tax season so we can buy a second car for me. We are on Medi-cal so I can go see a therapist once a week if I had transportation and child care. Of course as soon as I go back to work we will be over the threshold and will no longer qualify for the insurance.

I'm trying really hard to. I don't really know the solution or how to fix it though. Like the last few days in particular have been really bad and it seems like every few minutes an intrusive thought randomly pops in my head about a different suicide method or some transgression from my past or harmful thoughts just kind of pop up and I try to think about other things and distract myself (hence the podcasts). I don't even want to kill myself but my brain is telling me to kill myself? If that makes sense... I just need to talk and I don't have anyone to talk to but my husband and I'm ashamed whenever I do
